review_candidates.title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities • Take ownership of the existing mobile and backend codebase. • Build, maintain, and improve features across the mobile application and backend. • Implement and maintain points, rewards, balances, earning rules, redemption logic, eligibility rules, limits, and related user progression mechanics. • Build and maintain transaction histories, activity logs, reward states, and user-facing balance updates. • Develop and maintain flows involving authentication, user profiles, referrals
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer We’re looking for a senior, hands-on engineer to take ownership of the technical development of an existing mobile-first consumer product. This is a hands-on engineering role. • Translate founder feedback, product requirements, and UX changes into production-ready implementation. The founder will provide product direction, priorities, feedback, feature requirements, and expected behavior. You will be responsible for deciding how those requirements should be implemented technically and for maintaining the overall quality and stability of the codebase.
